dct_title_s: Damage assessment in Dinagat Island, Region XIII of Philippines as of 23 December 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20211216PHL** This map illustrates potentially damaged structures and buildings in Dinagat Island, Region XIII, the Philippines as observed from a Pleiades image acquired on 23 December 2021. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT and Copernicus EMS identified 3,278 damaged structures, 523 potentially damaged structures, and 3 potentially damaged ports. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT.
